brief.headline: Push for price to ₹0.65–0.80/pc (market headroom at volume) and pay in 15 days to free ₹2.60 L cash while qualifying Manjushree or Mold-Tek as second source.

priceAsk.summary: Target ₹0.65–0.80/pc on the 28 mm cap, down from the typical ₹0.85–0.95/pc band.
priceAsk.basis: Market research shows the typical ask is ₹0.85–0.95/pc, but there's modest headroom down to ₹0.65–0.80/pc at higher volume or looser specification — we spend ₹63.21 L annually, so volume justifies the lower end.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Offer to pay in 15 days instead of 30 days.
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Frees ₹2.60 L cash for us by shortening the cycle by 15 days.

brief.financialLeverage: Bprex publishes no financials, so we can't see their profit, debt or cash position. That means we lean on our own data and the backup plan. We spend ₹63.21 L a year with them — meaningful business for a private converter. With four strong alternates ready to qualify (Manjushree at ₹2569.83 Cr revenue, Mold-Tek at ₹946.50 Cr, both healthy), we have real walk-away power. Push firmly on price and payment, but frame it as partnering at scale — not a squeeze we can't verify they can handle.

evidence.point: Our annual spend with Bprex is ₹63.21 L.
Market asking price for a 28 mm PP cap typically sits at ₹0.85–0.95/pc.
At higher volume or looser spec, market research shows modest headroom down to ₹0.65–0.80/pc.
Paying 15 days earlier frees ₹2.60 L cash for FDC.
HDPE resin import unit value stands at 87.61 ₹/kg, giving a raw-material benchmark.
Manjushree Technopack, a top second-source candidate for pharma bottles and caps, has revenue of ₹2569.83 Cr and health score B (65/100).

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter at ₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health B (65/100) — pharma bottles, caps, preforms; top second-source candidate.

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader at ₹946.50 Cr revenue, health B (73/100) — strong, profitable; robust alternate for bottles and closures.

alternates.name: Reliance Industries Limited (lead to qualify)
alternates.why: Pan-India manufacturer lead — verify capability and MOQ before RFQ; medium confidence.

risks: Bprex's financials aren't public, so we're flying blind on their cash position — don't push so hard we destabilise a supplier we depend on for ₹63.21 L of packaging.
The ₹0.65–0.80/pc target assumes higher volume or looser spec; if our order size or tolerances don't flex, they may hold at ₹0.85/pc.
None of the alternates are qualified yet — start the RFQ process with Manjushree and Mold-Tek now so we have real backup by next review.
Offering 15-day payment saves us ₹2.60 L, but only works if Bprex values early cash enough to cut price — test their interest before committing.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We're looking at ₹63.21 L a year with you and see market pricing for similar caps at ₹0.65–0.80 at volume — let's talk about how we get there, and whether paying you in 15 days instead of 30 helps.
